data.action: 端坐在复古花窗飘窗软垫上，膝上摊开羊皮纸诗集，轻抚书页，转头温柔微笑
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, poetic solitude
data.description: 【薇薇安娜 · 莱塔尼亚书斋的月下长诗】莱塔尼亚古老宏伟的皇家哥特图书馆内，高耸入云的胡桃木书架环绕四周。薇薇安娜身着深蓝天鹅绒蕾丝贵族礼裙，静静坐在雕花彩绘玻璃窗边的软垫长椅上，膝上摊开一本手抄诗集，月光如银纱般披拂在她金色的巨角与发丝上——「‘当烛火在长夜中熄灭，唯有诗篇在星尘中永生。’……博士，你也喜欢这首诗吗？」
data.lighting: 彩绘玻璃透入的静谧冷月光与黄铜台灯微光
data.location: 莱塔尼亚大图书馆月光花窗边
data.promptProse: Inside a magnificent multi-story gothic library in Leithanien, Viviana Droste sits peacefully on a velvet-cushioned bay window seat beneath towering walnut bookshelves. She wears a romantic deep sapphire-blue velvet gown with delicate sheer lace sleeves, holding an open leather-bound poetry anthology with graceful fingers. Pale silver moonlight streams through ornate stained glass windows, casting enchanting crystalline patterns across her magnificent golden antlers and wavy flaxen hair. A poetic eye-level medium shot captures her ethereal serenity, literary grace, and gentle smile with sublime key visual artistry.
data.title: 薇薇安娜 · 莱塔尼亚书斋的月下长诗
